# Scientific Calculator

> A free scientific calculator that works offline: fractions, trigonometry, logarithms, formulas and constants, a unit converter, a graph, a solver, statistics, matrices and complex numbers, and a history of past calculations. Nothing leaves your browser.

A static web app (no account, no server, no tracking): everything is calculated in the browser. Installable as an app on iOS, Android and desktop. Also available as a Chrome extension.

## Links
- [Calculator](https://raad.dev/calculator/): the app, with options and a guide to every function
- [For schools and organizations](https://raad.dev/calculator/admin): turning features of the Chrome extension off for students, from the Google Admin Console
- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/raad-altaie/scientific-calculator): README, tests, MIT license

## Facts
- Precision: about 15 significant digits (IEEE 754 doubles), shown to 13.
- Angle units: degrees, radians, gradians. Fraction mode. Fix, Sci and Eng formats.
- Panels: formulas and constants; unit converter; graph (functions, sliders, roots and crossings, areas, derivatives, equations and inequalities of x and y, polar and parametric curves, best fits); solver (roots of equations in exact form as well, inequalities, turning points, polynomials, linear systems, two curves, integrals, limits, differential equations, probability); statistics (mean, median, standard deviation, min, max); numbers (matrices with eigenvalues, complex numbers, bases and bits, IEEE 754, prime factors, GCD and LCM).
- Author: Raad Altaie. License: MIT.
